scope: Author published experiment runtime and original current-PID formal phase metrics. Evidence index only; not a new method, threshold, workload, scheduler or launch configuration.
criterion: Compare against authors recorded experimental data with explicit hardware, model, token workload and execution differences. Native same-card profiles diagnose gaps; they do not replace the author reference.

current_native_profile.scope: First bounded worker iterations of one existing batch per rank; full-call counters and duration recorded, duration includes profile overhead.
findings: Prefix cache is active in these batches; misses do not equal all prompt tokens.
Native LLM.generate returns the full batch before the bridge replies to owner requests; short requests cannot advance their environment until that batch finishes.
Average generated tokens per worker iteration is a workload proxy including prefill; not an exact active decode batch statistic.
No extra generation, new engine, sampler, numerical change or asynchronous runtime was deployed.

interpretation: Raw author and current wall-clock times differ; no normalized slowdown or parity claim is made. GPU count and parameter count do not justify linear speed normalization.
